question: New Rihanna Album before GTA VI?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Rihanna officially releases a new album before Grand Theft Auto VI is officially released in the US. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

If neither occurs by July 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to 50-50.

For the purposes of this market, "release" refers to the game becoming publicly available for purchase or download in the US. Early access, beta versions, other forms of pre-release availability, or leaks will not count as an official release. If the release is only for certain consoles (e.g. Xbox Series X/S) it will count.

The resolution source for the release of GTA VI is official information from Rockstar Games or its parent company, Take-Two Interactive.

Officially released means that a newly released album is officially available for download or streaming (not including live events) by the resolution date.

Re-releases, deluxe editions, compilations, or greatest hits albums will not count, unless they contain at least 50% tracks that have never been officially released in any format prior to the album's release.

The resolution source for the album release will be any official streaming or download site, e.g. Apple Music or Spotify.

events.title: What will happen before GTA VI?
events.description: This is a market on predicting events that will occur before the release of Grand Theft Auto VI.

eventMetadata.context_description: Rockstar Games' confirmed November 19, 2026, release date for Grand Theft Auto VI, following two delays from an earlier 2025 target and a May 2026 window, has defined the narrow timeframe traders are evaluating. The studio remains laser-focused on polishing the open-world title set in Vice City and Leonida, with Take-Two Interactive reaffirming the schedule in recent earnings calls and minimal signals of competing major releases from the publisher in the interim. Ongoing GTA Online updates and potential late-cycle marketing moves like additional trailers represent the most credible near-term Rockstar activity, while unconfirmed rumors around projects such as Bully 2 or Max Payne continue to circulate without official traction. Market sentiment reflects the high bar for any event to resolve ahead of the locked-in launch.

question: Will Harvey Weinstein be sentenced to no prison time?
description:
This market will resolve according to the prison sentence, if any, imposed on Harvey Weinstein as part of his ongoing New York retrial (People of the State of New York v. Harvey Weinstein) by July 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET.

This market will resolve immediately based on the first sentence rendered in this case, regardless of any appeals. If Weinstein is found not guilty, there is a mistrial, or if the first sentencing does not include any jail or prison time, this market will resolve to "No Prison Time."

If no sentencing takes place by July 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will also resolve to "No Prison Time."

If the sentence falls exactly between two brackets, then this market will resolve to the higher range bracket.

For the purposes of this market, it does not matter whether the sentence is concurrent or consecutive to any existing sentence Weinstein is already serving. The market will resolve based on the total prison sentence imposed in this case.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the New York court system or other involved U.S. government sources; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description:
**Traders see an 81.6% implied probability of no additional prison time primarily because Weinstein’s California 16-year sentence already ensures long-term incarceration, while repeated New York mistrials and hung juries have weakened the case for meaningful new penalties.** 

The 2020 New York conviction was overturned on appeal, a 2025 retrial produced a split verdict with one conviction, one acquittal, and a mistrial on the rape count, and a May 2026 third trial on the remaining charge ended in another mistrial after the jury deadlocked. With Weinstein now 74 and in declining health, any potential New York resolution—whether through a fourth trial or plea—appears likely to result in concurrent or minimal additional time rather than stacked decades. The market’s low odds for 20–30 years or longer reflect skepticism that prosecutors can secure a conviction strong enough to extend his effective sentence substantially before his health or the California term renders further punishment largely symbolic. Upcoming developments center on the June 24, 2026 hearing, where Manhattan prosecutors will decide whether to pursue another trial on the unresolved rape allegation.

question: Will the Carolina Hurricanes win the 2026 NHL Stanley Cup?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if the Carolina Hurricanes win the 2026 NHL Stanley Cup. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

This market will resolve to “No” if it becomes impossible for this team to win the 2026 NHL Stanley Cup based off the rules of the NHL.

The resolution source for this market will be information from the NHL.

events.title: 2026 NHL Stanley Cup Champion
events.description: This market is to predict the winner of the 2025–26 NHL Stanley Cup championship.

eventMetadata.context_description: The 2026 Stanley Cup Final between the Carolina Hurricanes and Vegas Golden Knights remains deadlocked at 2-2 heading into Game 5 at Carolina’s home ice. The Hurricanes seized momentum by evening the series with a 5-3 road win in Game 4, powered by Jordan Staal’s two goals and strong relief work from backup goaltender Brandon Bussi after Frederik Andersen was scratched. Vegas had built a 2-1 lead through high-event wins featuring Mitch Marner’s production and overtime heroics, but the back-and-forth results, including multiple multi-goal comebacks, underscore the even matchup of two top regular-season clubs with comparable playoff depth and special-teams execution. Both rosters enter Game 5 at full health, with the slight trader edge to Carolina reflecting home-ice leverage and recent road resilience in a best-of-seven that has produced four one-goal or overtime decisions.

Vegas had built a 2-1 lead through high-event wins featuring Mitch Marner’s production and overtime heroics, but the back-and-forth results, including multiple multi-goal comebacks, underscore the even matchup of two top regular-season clubs with comparable playoff depth and special-teams execution. Both rosters enter Game 5 at full health, with the slight trader edge to Carolina reflecting home-ice leverage and recent road resilience in a best-of-seven that has produced four one-goal or overtime decisions.
